title: Robinhood Markets, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, these subsidiaries were in compliance with their respective regulatory capital requirements.
summary: The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports USD 1.308 billion quarterly revenue, USD 561 million net income attributable to Robinhood, USD 9.541 billion stockholders' equity, USD 5.362 billion cash and USD 2.170 billion long-term borrowings. Transaction revenue rose, but crypto revenue declined; credit-loss expense, operating costs and stock compensation increased. All named broker-dealer and futures subsidiaries exceeded regulatory net-capital requirements, while customer, counterparty, market, regulatory and rate sensitivity remain material.
